mechanism: directional persistence expressed as a close outside an ATR-scaled Keltner envelope while channel volatility expands and EMA trend remains aligned
payer_constraint: slow repositioning and delayed trend reversal among participants during persistent directional flow; hypothesis only
entry_event: closed-bar Keltner breakout with expansion_ratio>=1, EMA alignment and anti-chase bound
regime_no_trade: contracting channel, stale/missing data, trend disagreement, ambiguous trigger, excessive chase, or insufficient cost budget
timeframe: 1h structural baseline; economic evaluation horizon remains separately frozen
invalidation: 1.25 ATR initial stop; no adverse add
exit_policy: 48-bar timeout, favorable-progress ATR/structure trailing, runner enabled, no evaluator-owned exit
sizing_turnover: 0.5% equity risk capped at 15% notional; one transition entry and 2-bar cooldown
cost_handling: verified round-trip cost authority mandatory; minimum structural move/cost ratio 1.25

sources.role: separate momentum signal from volatility scaling

falsification: prospective Keltner-break intents must outperform direction-flip, time-placebo and delayed-entry controls net of frozen costs; otherwise reject this policy version
